pages.title: Starcrystal Game
pages.text: The Starcrystal Game is a memory game. The NPC serves as a buffer in between selections. All lights are used in a single round.

pages.title: Unpowered Starcrystal
pages.text: Used to start the game, right-click with it on the Starcrystal Core, then give it to the NPC that appears to start the game.

pages.title: Electrified Quartz
pages.text: Electrified Quartz is used to charge the blocks you are selecting, consuming it in the process. Bring plenty!

pages.title: Starcrystal Capacitor
pages.text: A Starcrystal Capacitor is given for succesfully completing the game.
